title: Realistic Heights
description: Makes your real length, your minecraft length.
body:
# Heigth?
**Yes, its true. This code asks you your real height (in CM) and converts that to Minecraft units to make you your true heigth in Minecraft.**

This is perfect for Minecraft roleplays for youtube, tiktok, or just skits.
This would also be a fun Gimmick for YOUR server.

If you are American:
1 CM = 0.393701 Inch.


THIS IS A SIMPLE PLUGIN THAT DOES NOT ADD ALOT.
